boxes.name: east_0
boxes.query: SELECT TOP 600000 galaxy_id,halo_id,ra_true,dec_true,redshift_true,position_x,position_y,position_z,velocity_x,velocity_y,velocity_z,halo_mass,is_central FROM cosmodc2mockv1 WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra_true,dec_true),BOX('ICRS',71.2500000000,-42.8500000000,6.5000000000,4.9000000000))=1 AND (redshift_true>=0.75 AND redshift_true<1.16 AND halo_mass>=5000000000000.0)
